title: A foundation model for enhancing magnetic resonance images and downstream segmentation, registration and diagnostic tasks

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A foundation model for enhancing magnetic resonance images and downstream segmentation, registration and diagnostic tasks》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】In structural magnetic resonance (MR) imaging, motion artefacts, low resolution, imaging noise and variability in acquisition protocols frequently degrade image quality and confound downstream analyses.

evidence.text: In structural magnetic resonance (MR) imaging, motion artefacts, low resolution, imaging noise and variability in acquisition protocols frequently degrade image quality and confound downstream analyses.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A foundation model for enhancing magnetic resonance images and downstream segmentation, registration and diagnostic tasks》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Specifically, we trained a tissue-classification neural network to predict tissue labels, which are then leveraged by a 'tissue-aware' enhancement network to generate high-quality MR images.

evidence.text: Specifically, we trained a tissue-classification neural network to predict tissue labels, which are then leveraged by a 'tissue-aware' enhancement network to generate high-quality MR images.
